```{R eval=FALSE}
htlv1<-read_sheet("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/14eZCI8lRsfIebXu-tpAxbuPEOhE6moAnTDKKKUQyNOI/") 
metadata<-read_csv(file="~/Documents/Rstats/RepoGit/Rdev24b/Rdev24/data/0422/0502_metadatafinal.csv")
metadata<-read_csv("./data/0422/0502_metadatafinal.csv")

#Manipulation of the database
dbh1<-htlv1 %>%
  filter(QC==1) %>%
  select(1, 9, 12, 13, 15, 20) %>%
  left_join(., metadata[c(2, 6)], by=c("Accession"="Accession")) %>%
  mutate(Residence=toupper(Residence)) %>%
  mutate(residcat = case_when(
    Residence  %in% c("AMAZONAS", "LORETO", "MADRE DE DIOS", "SAN MARTIN", "UCAYALI") ~ "Amazon Region",
    Residence  %in% c("ANCASH", "AREQUIPA", "CALLAO", "ICA", "LA LIBERTAD",   "LAMBAYEQUE", "LIMA", "MOQUEGUA", "PIURA", "TACNA", "TUMBES") ~ "Coast Region",
    Residence %in% c("PUNO", "HUANCAVELICA", "HUANUCO", "APURIMAC", "AYACUCHO", "CAJAMARCA", "JUNIN", "PASCO",  "CUSCO") ~ "Andean Region",
    )) %>%
  mutate(residcat2 = factor(case_when(
    residcat  == "Coast Region" ~ "Coastal Region",
    residcat %in% c("Andean Region", "Amazon Region") ~ "Andean-Amazon Region"
    )))  %>%
  mutate(V2c = factor(case_when(
    V2  == "Africa" ~ "a-Afroamerican",
    V2 %in% c("Southamerican", "Transcontinental") ~ "a-Transcontinental"
    ))) 
#Saving my table
write.csv(dbh1, file="~/Documents/Rstats/RepoGit/Rdev24b/Rdev24/data/0422/00504_table1_db", row.names = FALSE)

dbh1<-read_csv("./data/0422/00504_table1_db")
#Table1
table1 <- dbh1 %>%
  select(Sex, Age, strongy, Type, V2c, residcat2) %>%
    tbl_summary(
  by=residcat2,
  missing = "no",
  statistic=list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
                 all_dichotomous() ~ "{n} ({p}%)",
                 Age ~ "{median} ({sd})"),
  digits= list(all_continuous() ~ c(1,1),
               all_categorical() ~ c(0,0)),
  type= list(Sex ~ "dichotomous",
             Age ~ "continuous",
             Type ~ "categorical",
             strongy ~ "dichotomous",
             V2c ~ "categorical"),
  value= list(Sex ~ "F",
             strongy ~ "YES"),
  label=list(Sex ~ "Female",
             Age ~ "Age, years",
             Type ~ "Clinical Subtype",
             strongy ~ "Strongyloides Coinfection",
             V2c ~ "Genotype"),
  sort= list(everything() ~ "frequency")
  ) %>%
  modify_header(label="**Variable**", all_stat_cols() ~ "**{level}**<br>N = {n} ({style_percent(p, digits=1)}%)"
  )  %>%
  modify_caption("Characteristics of Peruvian HTLV-1-infected individuals by geographic region") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  add_overall(last=FALSE, col_label="**Total**")   %>%
  add_p() %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  gtsave(filename="table1.docx", path="output/2405tree/")
```
